spec_title: Research Agent Specification: Laptop Electronics Drawing Type Discovery & Retrieval
count_note: The spec objective and title state 45 drawing types, but the Section 2 registry enumerates only 38 distinct entries (A01-A14, B01-B10, C01-C04, D01-D03, E01-E07). All 38 enumerated types are processed here. See reports/gap-report.md for the count reconciliation and the list of near-duplicate types (e.g. A04 vs E07 fab drawing; B01 vs B08 block diagram; B05 vs B07 thermal).

tier_legend.2: OEM technical docs + open hardware (Intel/AMD/FCC/Framework/MNT/KiCad) - high
tier_legend.3: Educational/reference (MIT OCW, university, NASA, manufacturer tutorials) - medium
tier_legend.4: Community/repair (EEVBlog, CircuitMaker, IPC preview docs) - low

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 Mainboard Interfaces Schematic (Intel Core Ultra Series 1)

validation.content_check: IEEE-315-style component symbols, net names, pin numbers and power-rail annotations present across six generation-specific interface schematics (11th Gen, 12th Gen, AMD 7040, AMD Ryzen AI 300, Chromebook, Intel Core Ultra Series 1).

records.notes: Real shipping laptop schematic published by the OEM under CC BY 4.0 - the best authorized, DMCA-free laptop schematic available. Framework publishes interface-level (not full net-by-net) schematics; IEEE 315 symbol conformance is visual, not stamped. Schematic PDFs: Mainboard_Interfaces_Schematic_*.pdf.
records.fallback_source: https://source.mnt.re/reform/reform - MNT Reform full KiCad schematic (CERN-OHL-S 2.0); or KiCad 'video' demo schematic (GPL v3)

retrieval.note: Six Framework interface schematics committed (11th/12th Gen, 7040, Ryzen AI 300, Chromebook, Intel Core Ultra Series 1); MNT Reform motherboard schematic PDF (CERN-OHL-S) committed as a second open specimen at sources/mnt-reform/.

records.example_title: IEEE 91 distinctive-shape and rectangular logic gate symbols (digital logic course reference)

validation.content_check: Gate symbols (AND/OR/NAND/NOR/XOR), signal labels and logic-family conventions per IEEE 91. No formal title block (symbol reference set, not a sheet).

records.notes: IEEE 91/91a is paywalled. No standalone laptop logic diagram exists as a separate document; logic in laptops appears inside schematics (A01). Recorded as a fair-use symbol reference. For a real applied example use the KiCad demo schematics which use IEEE 91-style symbols. human_review recommended to source a stamped IEEE 91 specimen figure.
records.fallback_source: https://www.allaboutcircuits.com/textbook/digital/chpt-3/logic-signal-voltage-levels/ - applied logic gate diagrams; KiCad demo schematics (GPL v3)

retrieval.note: Applied IEEE-91-style logic-gate symbols are present in the committed KiCad 'video' schematics. The normative IEEE 91/91a standard is paywalled (url_only).

records.example_title: KiCad 'video' demo PCB layout (.kicad_pcb)

validation.content_check: Copper traces visible on multiple layers, component footprints placed, layer color coding present. Full multi-layer routed board.

records.notes: Complete, openly licensed EDA project; opens natively in KiCad. EC-2 applies (software-native file). Viewer: KiCad PCB editor. GitLab is canonical; GitHub mirror provided as a web-renderable view.
records.fallback_source: https://gitlab.com/kicad/kicad/-/tree/master/demos/pic_programmer - KiCad pic_programmer demo PCB (GPL v3)

retrieval.note: Complete KiCad 'video' multi-layer routed PCB. Opens natively in KiCad PCB editor.

records.example_title: Sierra Circuits controlled-impedance layer stackup specimen (IPC-2141)

validation.content_check: All layers listed (copper + dielectric), thickness per layer, material type (FR-4/prepreg/core), target impedance per signal layer.

records.notes: IPC-2141/IPC-4101 are paywalled. Sierra Circuits publishes a fully annotated stackup specimen suitable as a reference. Framework Mainboard documentation references a 6-layer stackup; a real laptop stackup callout also appears inside the Framework fab context.
records.fallback_source: https://github.com/FrameworkComputer/Framework-Laptop-13 - Framework Mainboard stackup callout (CC BY 4.0)

retrieval.note: No real layer-stackup *drawing* is redistributable: IPC-2141/IPC-4101 paywalled; Sierra Circuits specimen is reference/fair-use. The committed KiCad video.kicad_pcb contains a 2-layer stackup definition.

records.example_title: KiCad 'video' demo Gerber set (RS-274X)

validation.content_check: One file per layer (top/bottom copper, soldermask, silkscreen, drill); RS-274X header present in generated Gerbers. Render via Tracespace.

records.notes: EC-2 applies. Gerbers are generated from the KiCad demo PCB; render online with Tracespace (https://tracespace.io). RS-274X is an open, freely published format spec (Ucamco). Title block is N/A for Gerber data layers.
records.fallback_source: https://www.ucamco.com/en/gerber - Ucamco Gerber X2 format spec (free) + reference Gerber sets

retrieval.note: Gerber RS-274X set is a generated KiCad output; source project committed. Render with Tracespace.

records.license: Reference / fair use (educational, cites ASME Y14.5)

validation.content_check: At least one feature control frame with geometric tolerance symbol (e.g. position), datum references A/B/C, and material condition modifier (MMC/LMC) per ASME Y14.5.

records.notes: ASME Y14.5-2018 is paywalled. GD&T Basics provides a faithful, well-attributed feature-control-frame specimen for educational reference. Purchase the normative standard from ASME for a stamped specimen.

retrieval.note: ASME Y14.5-2018 paywalled; GD&T Basics feature-control-frame specimen is reference/fair-use. No redistributable GD&T drawing committed.

records.example_title: Sierra Circuits solder-paste stencil design specimen (aperture + area ratio)

validation.content_check: Aperture shapes per pad, area-ratio calculation example, paste-reduction percentage callouts per pad type per IPC-7525.

records.notes: HC-05: IPC-7525 is paywalled and no open-hardware laptop publishes stencil drawings. Sierra Circuits / Sunstone tutorials provide annotated specimens with area-ratio math. The KiCad demo also generates a paste layer (top/bottom paste) that can be rendered as the stencil aperture set.
records.fallback_source: https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-services or KiCad demo paste layer (GPL v3) for an actual aperture set

retrieval.note: Solder-paste/stencil aperture set is the generated KiCad paste layer; source project committed. IPC-7525 paywalled; Sierra/Sunstone tutorials url_only.

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 connector pinout / interface harness documentation

validation.content_check: Connector pinout tables (webcam IPEX, eDP display, audio, speaker, battery, input cover, fan, RTC) with conductor/pin assignments; connector part numbers. Wire gauge / pull-force not specified (cable details are connector-side).

records.notes: Framework documents connector pinouts and part numbers for the internal harnesses (real laptop). IPC/WHMA-A-620 is paywalled. Full harness drawings with pull-force and wire gauge are not published; pinout tables are the closest authorized real example.
records.fallback_source: IPC/WHMA-A-620 specimen (paywalled) or TI/connector-vendor harness drawing app notes

retrieval.note: Framework connector pinout documentation + two connector datasheets (ACES 50458, AUSB0534) committed. IPC/WHMA-A-620 paywalled.

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 Mainboard system block diagram (README)
records.file_format: PNG/SVG in README + PDF schematic sheet 1

validation.content_check: Named subsystem boxes (SoC/CPU, PCH, memory, storage, display, USB-C/Expansion, EC) with directional bus arrows. Present in Framework Mainboard README and schematic title sheet.

records.notes: Real laptop block diagram from the OEM under CC BY 4.0. Intel Alder Lake / Raptor Lake Platform Design Guides (Intel EDC, reference-only) provide an equivalent reference-design block diagram but cannot be redistributed.

retrieval.note: Framework Mainboard README system block diagram committed; interface block diagram also on schematic sheet 1 (committed PDFs). Intel Platform Design Guide is reference-only (url_only).

validation.content_check: Named voltage rails, regulator stages and load branches present in Framework Mainboard README power tree. Sequencing detail is partial.

records.notes: HC-02: power trees are normally buried in 200-400 page platform PDFs. Framework publishes a real laptop power tree under CC BY 4.0 (best authorized source). TI PowerLab notebook reference designs provide full rail/regulator/current-rating power trees as a Tier-2 fallback.

records.example_title: JEDEC DDR5 fly-by CA-bus routing topology (JESD79-5D)
records.license: JEDEC reference (free download with registration; redistribution restricted)

validation.content_check: DDR5 memory device footprints, fly-by CA-bus routing topology, DQ/DQS point-to-point routing, stub/termination callouts. (CA bus = fly-by; DQ/DQS = direct.)

records.notes: B04 best source is the JEDEC normative figure (free with registration). For an applied laptop example, an Intel DDR5 Platform Design Guide (EDC, reference-only) shows the routed mainboard topology. JEDEC content cannot be redistributed.

records.governing_standard: FCC Part 15 (test report) - no drawing standard
records.example_title: FCC OET RF test report 'Internal Photos' showing shield-can placement (laptop)
records.native_format: Internal-photos / RF-shielding section of test report

validation.content_check: Shield-can placement over PCB shown in 'Internal Photos'; ground-stitching via pattern and EMI-filter component locations visible. FCC ID + grant present.

records.notes: HC-06: OEM EMI drawings are internal; FCC test reports are the only public exposure of shield layout, and they are public domain. Search the OET database by applicant (Framework Computer / Dell / Lenovo) and open the 'Internal Photos' exhibit. A specific FCC ID must be selected at retrieval time (search is the stable entry point).
records.fallback_source: site:fcc.gov 'internal photos' laptop shielding filetype:pdf - direct exhibit PDFs in the OET database

retrieval.note: FCC OET 'Internal Photos' exhibits are public domain but no single FCC ID was pinned (search entry point); flagged human_review. Recorded as link.

records.example_title: AMD Ryzen / Framework AMD mainboard functional block diagram

validation.content_check: Functional blocks (SoC functional units, I/O controllers, power, EC) with signal-flow arrows. Present in Framework AMD Ryzen AI 300 interface schematic / README.

records.example_title: Texas Instruments analog signal-flow diagram (audio/amplifier app note)

validation.content_check: Directional signal-flow nodes (gain stages, filters, mixers) with named signals. Power topologies poster shows analogous formal flow blocks.

records.notes: EC-5: formal signal-flow graphs are rare in laptop electronics (represented instead by block diagrams). Best real-world specimen is a TI analog/audio application note. Note in output: this drawing type's laptop presence is limited; audio codec/amplifier signal paths are the closest match.
records.fallback_source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ - TI audio codec / class-D amplifier app note signal-flow diagrams

retrieval.note: TI signal-flow application note is publicly downloadable but copyright-restricted (no redistribution). Recorded as link.

records.example_title: IEEE 315A single-line diagram symbols (power architecture overview)

validation.content_check: Single-line representation of a power distribution path with IEEE 315A symbols (source, protection, loads).

records.notes: EC-5: single-line diagrams belong to power systems, not laptop PCB design. In a laptop the nearest analog is the high-level power-architecture overview (covered by B02 power tree). Recorded as an educational IEEE 315A reference with a note on limited laptop applicability.
records.fallback_source: University EE power-systems course single-line diagram example (Tier 3)

retrieval.note: IEEE 315A single-line symbols; limited laptop applicability. Reference/fair-use only, nothing redistributable committed.

records.example_title: Open-hardware boardview derived from Framework / KiCad PCB (pad-level net map)
records.native_format: Boardview (.fz / .brd) or KiCad PCB as source

validation.content_check: Pad-level net names, board outline, top + bottom copper sides. Boardview can be generated from the openly licensed KiCad/Framework PCB source without DMCA risk.

records.notes: HC-01: no formal standard; Apple/OEM .fz/.brd files carry DMCA risk and are REJECTED (louis.center, schematics.guru excluded). Viewer: OpenBoardView / FlexBV; Tracespace for Gerber rendering.

retrieval.note: Boardview (.fz/.brd) is generated by converting the committed KiCad/Framework open PCB via OpenBoardView/FlexBV. No DMCA-risk OEM mirror used.

records.license: Public (SMBus spec freely downloadable from smbus.org)

records.native_format: State transition diagram in EC firmware docs/source

Chromium EC (BSD-3) documents the x86 chipset power-state machine; if found only as ASCII/Mermaid, record as-is and note a rendered SVG can be generated. Specific files vary by tree (usb_power.md, low_battery_startup.md present; power-sequencing state machine is in the power/ chipset source).

retrieval.note: Chromium EC firmware docs with state machines committed: low_battery_startup.md, usb-tcpmv2.md (TCPMv2 state machine), usb-c.md, usb_power.md (BSD-3).

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 isometric view (rendered from CAD.stp)

validation.content_check: Isometric (equal 120-degree axis) pictorial of the laptop assembly with proportional dimensions, generated from Framework Laptop 13 CAD.stp.

records.notes: Framework Laptop 13 CAD.stp (and Pro CAD.stp) render directly to an isometric pictorial. ASME Y14.3 governs the isometric convention (paywalled). Service-manual isometrics (iFixit) are an alternative real example.
records.fallback_source: https://www.ifixit.com/Device/Framework_Laptop - service-manual isometric views (CC BY-NC-SA)

retrieval.note: Isometric render is generated from Framework CAD .stp (url_only, 21 MB). iFixit isometric is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial, not committed). Recorded as links.

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 exploded assembly (repair/service guide)

validation.content_check: Numbered part callouts, fastener specifications, and explode-direction lines. Framework CAD + repair guides provide the part breakdown; iFixit teardown shows the explode sequence.

records.notes: Framework is designed for repair and publishes CAD + structured repair guides; the modular assembly breaks out naturally into an exploded diagram (CC BY 4.0). iFixit Framework teardown is the canonical exploded view.
records.fallback_source: https://www.ifixit.com/Device/Framework_Laptop - Framework exploded teardown (CC BY-NC-SA)

retrieval.note: Exploded view is generated from Framework CAD .stp (url_only, 21 MB); iFixit teardown is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial, not committed). Recorded as links.

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 chassis / printable-case mechanical files

validation.content_check: Enclosure outline with dimensions, mounting bosses/standoffs, port cutouts, and fastener locations. Framework Laptop 13 CAD.stp + Mainboard 'Printable Case'/OpenSCAD sources.

records.notes: Framework publishes full chassis CAD (CAD.stp) plus OpenSCAD/printable-case mechanical sources under CC BY 4.0 - the best real laptop chassis drawing available.
records.fallback_source: https://source.mnt.re/reform/reform - MNT Reform CNC case STEP files (CERN-OHL-S 2.0)

retrieval.note: Framework OpenSCAD mechanical source (tray.scad) committed as a chassis/enclosure mechanical specimen. Full chassis CAD .stp (21 MB) and Printable Case STLs are url_only.

records.example_title: Framework Laptop 13 Mainboard 2D fabrication-context drawing (real laptop) + KiCad demo fab sheet

validation.content_check: Board outline with dimensions, mounting-hole/connector locations, layer/stackup callout context. Framework 2D mainboard drawing is the real laptop variant; KiCad demo provides a complete IPC-style fab sheet with drill legend.

records.notes: Near-duplicate of A04 (Fabrication Drawing). This entry favors the real laptop source (Framework Mainboard 2D, CC BY 4.0); A04 favors the KiCad-generated full fab sheet + Sierra Circuits IPC-2221 annotated specimen. IPC-2221 compliance is structural, not stamped.
records.fallback_source: https://gitlab.com/kicad/kicad/-/tree/master/demos/video - KiCad complete fab drawing (GPL v3); https://www.protoexpress.com/kb/pcb-fabrication-notes/ (Tier 3)

retrieval.note: Framework Mainboard 2D fabrication-context drawing (PDF) committed; KiCad demo provides the full generated IPC-style fab sheet (project source committed).

retrieval_summary.note: Only redistributable artifacts are committed (CC BY 4.0 Framework, GPL v3 KiCad, BSD-3 Chromium EC, CERN-OHL-S MNT Reform, public-domain NASA). 'generated_from_committed' means the named drawing is a standard KiCad output produced from the committed project source (run the generation_command). url_only = paywalled / reference-only / free-but-copyright-restricted, recorded as links per the links-only policy.
